_banner: DEVELOPMENT TOOL -- NOT A GATE. On-road IMU settle metric (settle_peak_imu_jerk / settle_peak_imu_decel) remains the promoter. Do NOT wire this into similarity_gate or any pass/fail gate. This curve exists only for offline sim iteration of the anti-stiction pre-release.
confounds: HEV: regen vs friction not separable (regenBraking always False, brake always 0); residual is a LUMPED net-decel-vs-v curve, not physical friction. Brake temperature unobservable. ~32 route-correlated stops, low-speed/driveway-skewed.

holdout_leave_one_route_out.fold_param_spread_note: min/median/max of each coefficient across leave-one-route-out folds; wide swings indicate the coefficient is poorly constrained at this n.

model_form: friction_residual(v) = c0 + c1 * exp(-v / v0); a_imu_pred = linear_plant + friction_residual

settle_window.definition: matches build_event_store.settle_imu_jerk() window (engaged + long-control-active, terminates at first v_ego <= standstill_speed)

stored_peak_imu_jerk_distribution.note: recorded for reference only; the 20 Hz held jerk is aliased/artifact-prone and is NOT a fit or holdout target -- fit/ranking are on the decel channel.

signal: DECEL channel: residual = a_long_imu(livePose.accelerationDevice.x) - a_ego(wheel), 20 Hz held; jerk channel deliberately NOT used (aliased per assess phase).
verdict: coarse-provisional (assess 2026-06-14). Trust for: relative harsh-vs-smooth ranking of terminal settles in offline sim, and reproducing the wheel-blind grab DECEL the linear plant misses. Do NOT trust for: absolute physical friction values, jerk-peak magnitude, rolling-traffic stops (data is low-speed-skewed), or any gating decision.
